proposal.reason: Primary change is in enqueue: kernel launches now pass a packed argument buffer plus explicit byte size and the global kernel-arg budget increases to 4 KiB. Add symmetric because symmetric multi-task planning switches from fixed 4 KiB pool allocation/reclaim to variable-sized scoped argument allocation using calculated size. Add kernels because built-in device kernel signatures and shared argument-storage types change from 1 KiB to 4 KiB capacity (API/ABI surface). Add kernel-plugin because ext-kernel launch macros and call sites change to by-value struct launch semantics with explicit launch-buffer handling; CE/OKI and P2P DMA edits are mechanical call-shape updates only.
